## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes

- [ ] External CLI tools go through `ctf_api/core/sandbox.py`
- [ ] New files have a licence (REUSE catch-all covers most; add to `REUSE.toml` if not)
- [ ] I agree to contribute under GPL-3.0-only (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md))
